Container.Name: redman
Container.Overview: RedMan — Homelab management tool for Unraid. SSD backups with versioning, cross-site Hyper Backup (rsync over SSH), Rclone cloud sync, and Docker container monitoring with 24h metrics. React + Express + SQLite.
Container.Requires: Before first start, run the RedMan Unraid backup-user bootstrap for this App Data path. The default template does not publish the unauthenticated pairing/peer port; add a trusted LAN/VPN-only mapping with firewall restrictions when inbound peers are required. Docker monitoring additionally requires the RedMan exact-path read and control proxy sidecars on the same Docker network.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the RedMan web interface

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Path to store the RedMan database

Config.Name: Backup User Authorized Keys
Config.Description: Host authorized_keys file for the restricted redman-backup user

Config.Name: REDMAN_STORAGE_ROOTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths exposed in path pickers

Config.Name: REDMAN_MEDIA_ROOT
Config.Description: Container directory monitored for removable media

Config.Name: REDMAN_SHARE_CONFIG_DIR
Config.Description: Unraid share configuration directory

Config.Name: Share Config
Config.Description: Unraid share configuration files (auto-detect shares)

Config.Name: User Shares
Config.Description: Unraid user shares (read/write for backup sources, restores, pulls, and downloads)

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Unraid cache drive (SSD backup sources)

Config.Name: AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: Main API authentication mode: proxy (Pangolin/forward-auth) or local (RedMan login)

Config.Name: PROXY_AUTO_PROVISION_ROLE
Config.Description: Role assigned to new trusted proxy identities; clear after expected users are provisioned

Config.Name: REDMAN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Exact public HTTPS origin, e.g. https://redman.example.com

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Exact Pangolin/Newt proxy source IP/CIDR seen by RedMan; broad RFC1918 ranges are rejected

Config.Name: REDMAN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN
Config.Description: Required one-time token for first admin creation in local mode

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node environment (leave as production)

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal web UI port

Config.Name: PEER_API_PORT
Config.Description: Internal peer API port

Config.Name: PEER_HOST
Config.Description: Numeric private SSH IP reachable by the other RedMan peer

Config.Name: DOCKER_HOST
Config.Description: Optional Docker socket-proxy origin; leave empty to disable Docker monitoring

Config.Name: DOCKER_CONTROL_HOST
Config.Description: Optional lifecycle-only Docker proxy origin; leave empty to disable container controls
